title: Mahou Gakuen Lunar!
overview:
Go wild with combination magic! A school RPG where all kinds of combinations lead to a wide variety of attacks.

This entry in the Lunar series takes you to a school of magic on Ien, an island that moves. Follow young student Ellie and her classmates through their school days and adventures, told across chapters with plenty of animated scenes.

Battles use turn-based commands. Combine the power of each party member to unleash combination magic, and experiment with different pairings to discover new attacks.

- 1 player

合体魔法で大暴れ！
いろんな組合せが多彩な攻撃を呼ぶ学園RPG
